notes.title: HELLO VIDEOGAMERS
notes.content:
Hey….Hi...uh Hello!

This is the first post for Bill Hates Videogames and we’ll be going over what the cheese this game is about.

[h1][b]What’s This?[/b][/h1]

It’s a videogame? Oh what kinda game? Well it’s like an adventure game but with more jokes and the main character doesn’t wanna be there, so he’s just kinda fumbling through it and...I should make this more concise...

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/efrmLaqN0HwUXCORlP/giphy.gif[/img]

Bill Hates Videgoames is a [strike]adventure[/strike] misadventure game about a [strike]hero[/strike] jerk named Bill who gets stuck inside a videogame and is trying [strike]his best [/strike]to find his way out. After unleashing a [strike]little [/strike]big evil on the world it’s up to Bill and a talking sword to undo the evilness and make things all goodsie like, but mostly Bill just wants to go home. You'll meet other characters along the way like a talking Boss statue head that is overworked a very old tree with memory loss and more stuff I come up with!

[h1][b]
[/b]Who?[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TF0FpUkrQ1tUfA1AZA/giphy.gif[/img]
Bill? He’s not your typical hero. Well he doesn’t even wanna be a hero or is one, he doesnt want to be here, not even in this post. Anyway...Bill is who you play as in this videogame aptly named “Bill Hates Videogames”. 

[h1][b]The Good Stuff[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38352204/cbf73a479f2d45299ba941ed50d706e0b26a6a5f.png[/img]

We’re still working on making the good stuff aka the stuff you’ll experience in this game. Right now you can walk around, eat trash, oh and did I mention there’s a fart button? That’s right gamers, you can fart at any time. Sometimes it does stuff, but for the most part it’s just kinda fun to press buttons...right so uh what’s going on with you? How’s your day? Oh right uhm like I said there’s more stuff we’re adding to the game so just watch this page and uh do the other stuff I mention below this.

If you’re interested in the game plz smash that [b]Wishlist[/b] button so we may thwart the monster that is the Steam algorithm and spread the word.

[b]I’ll be posting updates on[/b] billhatesgames.com [b]and here as well as we work on new features / systems so watch those spaces.[/b]
